description: Source code for a custom GatherOperator class that wraps around PyTorch's gather functionality, including input specification generation and code generation for tensor gathering operations.

classes.name: GatherOperator
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the gather operation, providing methods for input specification, code generation, and operation metadata.

methods.name: torch_op_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the corresponding PyTorch operation, 'torch.gather'.

methods.name: can_produce
methods.description: Checks if the operator can produce a tensor with the given output specification.

methods.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
methods.description: Generates input tensor specifications for the gather operation based on the output spec.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates Python code to perform the gather operation with appropriate index creation.
